dimensions.name: 拓扑与流程完整性
findings: 线性 DAG：requirements → long_task_ucd → design，共 3 个节点、2 条边，拓扑合法
startNode "requirements" 存在且可达，无孤立/不可达节点
每条边的 from/to 均指向有效节点 id
无分支、无循环，终端为 design 的 bp-advance ok
主要缺陷：缺少任何循环节点和任务分发机制，无法处理批量工作
suggestions: 若存在多文件并行处理需求，应增加 loop 节点和 tasks-schema
设计节点可考虑添加失败分支（edge with onFail）

dimensions.name: 门禁与失败恢复
findings: 关键缺陷：blueprint.json 中没有任何节点定义 onFail 规则
long_task_ucd 节点在 SKILL.md 正文中写了 <HARD-GATE> 文本约束，但这不是真正的框架门禁节点——它不是 review-skill 类型，没有绑定校验脚本，不报告 ok/failed/blocked 三态
所有 3 个节点均无 maxAttempts 限制
无任何硬性质量门禁节点
一旦任何节点执行失败，工作流会直接中止而无重试/回退机制
suggestions: 必须为每个 skill 节点添加 onFail 块，定义同层 rewindTo（如 long_task_ucd 失败则回到 requirements）
long_task_ucd 若需真门禁，应改为 review-skill 类型节点并绑定校验脚本
建议为关键节点设置 maxAttempts: 3 防止无限重试

dimensions.name: Skill 蓝图契合度
findings: requirements skill：与节点角色匹配，正确使用 {{HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR}} 占位符，流程清晰（mkdir→write→context→advance）
long_task_ucd skill：内容详尽但被截断（3385 字节），仅含 Step 1-4，缺少 Step 5-9 完整内容；HARD-GATE 文本不能替代真正的框架门禁节点
design skill：过于简略，仅 4 步，无实质性设计指导（架构/模块/数据流的具体提取方法缺失）
requirements 和 design 的 skill 均未定义下游所需的关键产物路径供 bp-context 正确传递
long_task_ucd 的 SKILL.md 内含 <HARD-GATE> 标记暗示作者意图是门禁，但节点类型仍为普通 skill
suggestions: design skill 应扩充：如何从 requirements.md 提取架构、模块、数据流的具体方法
long_task_ucd 需将 HARD-GATE 改为真正的 review-skill 节点，或移除该标记以避免误导
各 skill 应明确声明其产物路径供下游节点引用

dimensions.name: 通用化(跨语言/项目)
findings: 硬编码路径：docs/plans/*-srs.md、{{HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR}}/plans/
long_task_ucd 依赖特定文档命名规范（*-srs.md、*-ucd.md、YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-ucd.md）
设计阶段描述为"v8.5 demo blueprint"的特定上下文
输出结构固定（3-5 条核心功能、架构概览 1-2 段），不适配不同规模项目
SRS 的 FR-xxx/NFR-xxx 标记法是项目特定的标记体系
无参数化配置机制（如语言/框架/文档目录均可自定义）
suggestions: 将文档目录路径参数化，通过 {{VARS}} 或 tasks 传入
移除对 demo 特定上下文的引用
SRS 标记体系（FR-xxx）可通过占位符泛化

dimensions.name: 循环与任务结构
findings: 无任何 loop 节点
无 tasks-schema 声明
blueprint.json 中不存在 tasks 字段
无法处理批量/并行任务场景
suggestions: 若后续需要处理多文件或多模块，应设计 loop 节点 + tasks-schema
参考 tasks-schema 规范声明 requiredFields/doneValues/example

dimensions.name: 文档与可维护性
findings: 节点标题简洁：requirements、long_task_ucd、design，均有描述
startNode 明确指定
线性流程易理解，无歧义
无共享 reference 文档
long_task_ucd 被截断导致内容不完整
suggestions: 添加 shared reference 支持 SKILL.md 编写
补充节点间数据流说明（requirements 输出 → long_task_ucd 输入 → design 输入）

dimensions.name: 健壮性与边界
findings: 无 onFail 规则 → 任何节点失败均无恢复路径
design skill 缺少 HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR 不存在时的 mkdir 步骤
long_task_ucd 仅在文件缺失时跳过，未覆盖文件存在但内容为空的情况
requirements skill 无输入验证（用户消息为空时行为未定义）
设计节点无上下文预算意识，长文档可能导致截断
suggestions: 为每个节点添加强错误处理（mkdir、write、read 失败）
添加用户输入为空/不明确时的默认行为
设计节点应处理超长 requirements.md 的边界情况

dimensions.name: 清晰度与可读性
findings: Artifact uses consistent Chinese section headers (# 设计, ## 输入, ## 步骤)
Sequentially numbered steps (1-4) with clear progression
{{VAR}} placeholder syntax is consistent throughout
Step 1 '执笔' is ambiguous — could mean 'write to' or 'create' file
Description (v8.5 demo blueprint) suggests a highly specific context
Missing required content spec for the '前置条件不满足' message
suggestions: Clarify '执笔' action: write content into design.md vs. just create file
Specify minimum length/structure expectations for the blocked case message
Consider adding a step index or stage identifier in the name/description

dimensions.name: 可执行性与操作具体度
findings: Step 3 specifies three concrete content sections with guidance
Step 1 correctly handles missing prerequisites with explicit bp-advance blocked
Step 4 has clear success exit (bp-advance ok)
Step 2 '读取' is underspecified — no guidance on how to parse/interpret requirements.md content
No guidance on what to do if requirements.md exists but is empty or malformed
No guidance on whether to overwrite an existing design.md
suggestions: Step 2 should specify parsing approach or expected requirements.md format
Add guidance for malformed/empty requirements.md
Clarify overwrite vs. merge behavior for existing design.md

dimensions.name: 完备性与自足性
findings: Only handles the missing-file failure case; no other error scenarios
No input validation of requirements.md content
No success criteria beyond 'bp-advance ok'
Missing guidance on how to extract/interpret architecture, modules, and data flow from requirements
No handling for write failures to design.md
No recovery or rollback mechanism
suggestions: Add error handling for I/O failures, empty input, malformed content
Specify expected requirements.md format or provide parsing guidance
Add success criteria beyond exit code

dimensions.name: 技术合理性与无误导
findings: Placeholder {{HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR}} and {{REQUIREMENTS_PATH}} follow framework conventions
bp-advance blocked/ok exit semantics are correct
Sequential step flow is logical and sound
Step 1 correctly creates design.md with error message on missing input
No contradictory or misleading instructions
suggestions: Consider what happens if HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR itself doesn't exist — no mkdir implied
No mention of whether bp-advance url is inferred or must be provided

dimensions.name: 健壮性与边界覆盖
findings: Only covers two states: requirements.md exists (happy path) and missing (blocked)
No coverage for: empty requirements.md, permission errors, very large files, malformed placeholders
No mention of what happens if design.md already exists
Missing HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR is not handled
No step timeout or long-run protection
suggestions: Add I/O error handling for steps 1, 2, 3
Specify behavior when design.md pre-exists (overwrite, diff, skip)
Handle empty/invalid requirements.md gracefully

dimensions.name: 通用化与可复用性
findings: Skill is tightly coupled to a specific demo blueprint (v8.5 demo, Stage 2)
{{HARNESS_MEMORY_DIR}}/plans/ path is framework-specific and hardcoded
Output is narrowly scoped to a single design.md with fixed structure
Can be repurposed for other requirements→design workflows with path customization
Generic 'design' name is good for reuse, but description ties it to demo context
suggestions: Remove 'v8.5 demo blueprint' from description for broader applicability
Parameterize input/output paths for reuse across different project contexts
Abstract the output schema (architecture/modules/data-flow) as configurable

card.summary: 工作流拓扑合法但严重缺乏失败恢复机制（无 onFail 规则），且 long_task_ucd 的 HARD-GATE 仅为 SKILL.md 文本而非框架门禁节点，无实际约束力。requirements skill 质量尚可，long_task_ucd 内容详尽但被截断，design skill 过于简略且缺乏健壮性。整体泛化能力弱，hardcoded 路径和 v8.5 demo 特定上下文限制了跨项目复用。
topIssues: blueprint.json 所有节点均无 onFail 规则——节点失败将直接中止而无重试/回退
long_task_ucd 的 <HARD-GATE> 是文本标注而非框架门禁节点，无法起到真实验收约束作用
design skill 过于单薄（仅 4 步），缺少从 requirements 提取架构/模块/数据流的具体方法论
工作流无 loop 节点和 tasks-schema，无法处理批量或并行任务场景
硬编码路径（docs/plans/*-srs.md、v8.5 demo）严重制约泛化能力
